reviewer.conflict_declaration: The reviewer did not implement the corrections and verified an immutable clean checkout read-only.

methods: Verified exact HEAD and clean state before and after review.
Ran 26 source, knowledge, autonomy and controller tests: all passed, zero skipped.
Ran 16 pilot-report negative tests and 10 independent in-memory adversarial probes.
Validated 13 schemas and 15 fixtures plus five stored independent conformance results.
Verified the 100000-column CSV rejection occurred before Object.fromEntries; the 4096-column boundary passed.
Recorded the checked-in stale pilot report and local-only conformance as remaining release blockers, separate from source-security findings.

findings.summary: A wide CSV row could be materialized before the column budget was enforced.
findings.reproduction: A 100000-column input is now rejected before row-object construction; 4096 columns remain supported.

findings.summary: The source read did not recheck an ancestor change after opening.
findings.reproduction: The replacement fixture fails before source bytes are accepted after opening.

findings.summary: Source deadlines did not consistently cancel transport work or retire database connections.
findings.reproduction: HTTP body cancellation, SQL connection retirement/destruction and S3 AbortSignal propagation pass regression and independent in-memory probes.

findings.summary: Post-open realpath and stat are separate operations, not atomic confinement against repeated concurrent path replacement.
findings.reproduction: No remaining disclosure was reproduced in this bounded review; an adversarial local race campaign was not performed.

unresolved_risks: Source trees should be access-controlled or snapshotted; the review does not prove confinement against an actively racing local filesystem attacker.
The reviewer did not use real database/S3 services, perform a fresh network dependency audit or replay private pilot sources.
The reviewed commit still had a stale committed pilot report and local-only independent conformance; those remain separate release gates.
No external human audit or production-write review was performed.
attestation: An isolated AI-assisted reviewer reported security_verdict=pass_with_nonblocking_findings and zero unresolved Critical/High findings in the stated scope; its overall release verdict remained blocked by evidence gates.
claim_boundary: This is an owner-authorized AI-assisted source-security review, not an external human audit. The schema verdict supports bounded production-read preparation only. It does not authorize stable publication, production deployment, writes or managed autonomy.
